metadata.resourceNote: Server PID only; CPU = delta(user+system CPU time)/delta(monotonic wall time)*100; 100% is one core, may exceed 100%. ps TIME has 10ms resolution on macOS. Median/peak CPU across ~300ms intervals, mean is duration-weighted. Peak is sampled, not instantaneous. Load generator shares the host.
metadata.coldStartNote: Spawn to completion of first valid response, including imports/startup, TCP, first-route compilation and handler. GET/POST use independent fresh processes; retry only connection refusals every 5ms. OS/filesystem caches are NOT flushed; AOT build is excluded. firstRequestMs is the successful HTTP request duration including response body, not pure handler time.

conditions.note: Shared M2 Pro developer machine; existing Chrome/background workloads left running. Process-cold startup with OS/filesystem/Bun transpiler caches preserved. Cold trials and load trials are separate processes.
